name: Sticks to Serpents
body:
School necromancy; Level cultist 6, druid 6

Components V, S, M

Casting Time 1 standard action

Range Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Effect: 1 swarm per 4 caster levels

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw None; Spell Resistance no

This spell allows the caster to send the spirits of dead snakes into pieces of wood, bringing them to life. The caster can create 1 venomous snake swarm per 4 caster levels, provided sufficient material components are available. The caster can command the creatures as he wishes. The creatures act normally on the last round of the spell, and disappear at the end of their turn, leaving only a pile of twigs behind.

Material Component: One twig or small branch for each snake swarm animated.
